newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 19.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Trade and Energy Minister Lim Chang-yeul said on Monday that the solution to the Kia Group's problems is virtually in the hands of Kia chairman Kim Sun-hong.
- Chung Tae-soo, the jailed patriarch of the failed Hanbo Group, denied fraud and embezzlement charges during an appeals trial on Monday.

- In a move to drastically improve managerial transparency and the corporate system, the government will soon allow hostile mergers and acquisitions of Korean firms by foreign enterprises, officials said.
- Korea First Bank has decided to submit more drastic self-rescue plans to the Bank of Korea this week in an attempt to obtain the central bank's preferential low-interest loans.
- The groundbreaking ceremony for two 1,000-megawatt nuclear reactors to be provided by the Korean Peninsula Energy Development Organisation takes place at 2 p.m. on Tuesday in Sinpo, North Korea.
- The Korean currency hit a record low of 898.70 won against the U.S. dollar on Monday since March 1990.
